transcript.content: Can you please draft a sports clearance document for a teenager following their recent medical check-up? The document should include details like the teenager's name, age, the date of the check-up, confirmation of fitness for sports participation, and the doctor's signature line. Thank you!

I can draft that for you. I need a few details so I can make the document complete and, if you want, save it to the patient’s chart:

Please provide:
- Teenager’s full name
- Age (or date of birth)
- Date of the medical check-up (if different from today)
- Any restrictions/limitations (e.g., limited to non-contact sports, no heavy lifting, cleared with conditioning) or whether it’s full clearance
- Do you want this document authored by Dr. Samuel Osei and saved to the patient’s record here at Riverside Family Health?

If you’d prefer, I can also create a generic clearance form now with placeholders that you can fill in. Below is a ready-to-use draft you can copy, fill in, or confirm details for me to finalize and upload.

Draft Sports Participation Clearance

Patient name: ______________________________
Date of birth / Age: _________________________
Date of exam: ______________________________

To whom it may concern:

This is to certify that I examined the above-named patient on the date shown. Based on my assessment, the patient is:

( ) Cleared for full participation in all school and community athletic activities without restriction.
( ) Cleared for participation with the following restrictions: _______________________________
    ____________________________________________________________________________
( ) Not cleared for participation for medical reasons. Re-evaluation recommended on: ____________

Summary of exam findings (optional):
_____________________________________________________________________________________
_____________________________________________________________________________________

Recommendations (if any):
_____________________________________________________________________________________
_____________________________________________________________________________________

Physician name: Dr. Samuel Osei
Clinic: Riverside Family Health
Physician signature: ______________________________________
Date: ________________________

Physician contact: ___________________________ (phone/email)

Please tell me the patient details and whether to save this to the chart; I’ll finalize and upload it for you.

The teenager's name is Alex Johnson, age 15, check-up date was October 10, 2023, and they are cleared for full participation in all activities. Yes, please save this document authored by Dr. Samuel Osei to their chart. Thank you! [END]
